The /Public tree

Versioned machine-instruction data, mirroring unicode.org/Public.

Data is published under a case-sensitive /Public layout, one directory per release, exactly as unicode.org does. The Base tree ships SUCD.zip and per-component archives; the Extended tree ships ExtSUCD.zip, the extsucd.zip registry package and Plugin-SDK.zip.

Directory Purpose
0.1.0/ Versioned release data (sucd, sudat, names, sources, collation, sutf, charts, mappings, partitions)
latest/ Pointer to the current release
drafts/ Working drafts for the next release
zipped/ Download-ready archives (SUCD.zip, component zips, ExtSUCD.zip, Plugin-SDK.zip)
programs/ Official tooling (plugin_pack, plugin_verify, inspectors)
security/ CRC32c + Fletcher-64 attestations for every published release

Browse live: modules/unicode (Base) and modules/unicode-extended (Extended).
